update_contract.on_stage_start: Set exactly one active stage and preserve all later stages as locked.
update_contract.on_stage_fail: Record FAIL/BLOCKED evidence on the same node; do not activate another node.
update_contract.on_local_stage_pass: Record PASS_LOCAL and keep the next node locked until canonical push is verified.
update_contract.on_authorization: Record the exact authorized action scope without treating authorization as execution proof.
update_contract.on_stage_pass_pushed: Record validation, exact touched paths, checkpoint document and source commit SHA; verify pushed main; only then unlock the next node.
update_contract.ui_rule: Tree state mirrors plan/status data. UI state never becomes authority and never marks canonical PASS from authorization or narrative alone.
